title: Easy to Use
text: Easy to Use. Fireplace season is over, so we tried this out in the backyard fire pit. It was easy to use. There were no problems lighting it and getting it started. I didn't really notice any coffee scent to it, but it's possible I wasn't near enough to the fire. It seems pretty comparable to other starter logs.
